comments.body:
I'd like to 2 minutes to present [EIP-8333](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8333) for Hegota. We ran out of time last meeting.

Slide: https://gist.github.com/lodekeeper/ab3164dc62c81f2d172ae7ce0f0d2c55

I'd like to discuss reducing the CL block retention window: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12188/changes

Also a followup question on how clients behave during long periods of finality, ie whether all non-finalised blocks are stored (I think this behaviour should be the same across EL and CL)

I want to announce the decision made after a discussion on the EL breakout on [ACDT#92](https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/092/) (this Monday 17th of August) that we want to remove EIP-7610 from Glamsterdam.

Note that this is not a spec change. (I am also the person who PFId this EIP, and also Gary Rong `@rjl493456442`, one of the EIP authors, chimed in on this discussion giving the approval to remove it)

Please [**first approve and merge this PR**](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11855) and then approve this [draft PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12189) on EIPs, to avoid merge conflicts (I need to alter my PR#12189 after [PR#11855](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11855) is approved & merged 😄 👍 )

## Client teams, it would be very helpful if you were to use the same scale for non-headliner EIP prioritization.
This would allow quick (or even automated) summarising of all teams priorities ready for shortlisting.  Especially if you use the excellent Forkcast ranking.

_Please note, you can share your priorities however you like, using whatever scale you like.  Sharing using Forkcast, via URL and the same scale would just make the process of getting to shortlisting faster & easier._

Ethlabs used the following scale: (easier to follow their lead as they were one of the first to share)

[S-tier] strongly recommend inclusion
[A-tier] recommend inclusion if blockers are cleared (e.g., complexity assessment, impact analysis, path to adoption)
[B-tier] stretch goal
[D-tier] recommend rejection
[forming opinion] no opinion yet (EIPs left unranked)

Forkcast now labels D-tier as DFI.
https://forkcast.org/rank/
